purpose: Compact persistent business context for the future AI advisor. This is not the raw history database.
operatingPrinciples: 0 changes is a valid daily decision.
Do not restructure winners because of one weak day when the rolling window remains healthy.
Use funnel evidence to distinguish ad problems from landing/cart/checkout problems.
Budget cuts change pacing; pause is the hard stop when spend must stop.
Prefer one interpretable experiment over several simultaneous structural changes.
Every recommendation must include the strongest counterargument before approval.

strategy.winnerScalingStructure: CBO can become the scaling home for proven winners when budget is sufficient.
strategy.minimumCboBudgetNote: Intentionally unset. Do not invent a minimum before enough account-specific evidence is available.
strategy.testDecisionUnit: individual test/creative/ad set before account-wide restructure

alertPolicy.outsideReviewWindows: Only hard alerts should interrupt: spend ceiling, tracking failure, checkout/payment failure, or extreme deviation.
